formulaBlock.normalization: No split synonym entries; normalized positions = packet positions. E3: Parfum at 22; prominent = 1-21.

cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: SLES (2) defining, buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine (3), Decyl Glucoside (4), Coco-Glucoside (5); no reinforcing anionic -> moderate.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Three buffers plus lipids argue toward the milder side; C1 convention holds the value.

conditioningLevel.rationale: C2 met with a payload lipid in place of the silicone: prominent payload lipids (Squalane 9, Cocos Nucifera Oil 11, Dicaprylyl Ether 12, Hydrogenated Castor Oil 18) + cationic polymer (Guar HPTC 13) + pearlizing route (Glycol Distearate 17) + humectants (Panthenol 10, Glycerin 15); also W-RICH.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: No silicone; every lipid and the guar sit after Citric Acid (7), so levels are plausibly low and the care could be bounded (moderate).

weightPotential.rationale: W-RICH (prominent payload lipids converging with a cationic guar) but resetCapacity moderate (C1 with three buffers), so the high route needs converging persistent systems that reset does not offset; lipids are mostly liquid/light and late after Citric Acid -> moderate.
weightPotential.counterSignal: W-RICH present; three deposition families (payload_lipid, cationic_polymer, weak_refatter) incl. a waxy Hydrogenated Castor Oil.

depositionLoad.rationale: several lipids + one guar + weak refatter, all mid/late list

persistence.rationale: coconut oil and hydrogenated castor oil are somewhat substantive; squalane/ether are light

resetCapacity.rationale: effective C1 chassis with three buffers

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Plausible bounded conditioning residue from lipids + guar; not limited reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: high needs W-RICH plus limited (weak) reset, or multiple persistent systems not offset by reset; reset is moderate and the lipids are late/light. low would understate the converging lipid + cationic residue (W2).

focusPrimary.rationale: Formula supports moisture; focus needs a claim (F1).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Positioning hidden; CSA passes (Panthenol 10 comfort; Glycerin, lipids).

careDirection.rationale: Humectant cluster (Panthenol 10, Glycerin 15, Pantolactone 16) plus emollient lipids (Squalane, coconut oil, ether) and guar; no protein/damage cluster for repair.
